assumptions.statement: Official site and key-area polygons, statutory land-use controls, FAR, height, road redlines, ownership, surveyed buildings, municipal utilities, fire, flood, heritage and engineering constraints are not fully present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All exact locations, areas, building decisions and engineering works remain conceptual and must be recalculated or redesigned after official data and specialist review.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area geometries are the repository's provisional rough envelopes with official_boundary=false.
assumptions.impact: They support design generation and content review only; they are not approval boundaries or precise survey data.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints represent reversible ground-floor prototypes rather than surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: Footprint metrics describe the proposal geometry only and cannot be used as stock, demolition or development-capacity claims.

assumptions.statement: Open-bay hours, staffing, data processing and emergency procedures require named operators, owners and professional safety review.
assumptions.impact: No AI scene opens until an auditable pilot ticket, human fallback and stop mechanism are approved.
